item.title: It Is Done. Hail Satan.
item.description: An Iowa man has kicked off controversy over religious freedom in the small town of Ottumwa, Iowa by opening a city council meeting with a prayer to Satan, which then kicked off a debate about the proper time in the meeting agenda to undo the “curse.” On Tuesday night, Ottumwa resident, satanist, and former city council member Matt Dalbey took the podium to read an invocation to start a routine meeting of the council. “Thank you mayor, council. Let us pray,” Dalbey started. “Dear dark father, let us stand now unbowed and unfettered by arcane doctrines born of fearful minds and darkened times. Let us embrace the Luciferan impulse to eat off the tree of knowledge and dissipate our blissful and comforting delusions of old.” https://www.404media.co/it-is-done-hail-satan-city-immediately-regrets-new-religious-liberty-law-that-allows-prayer-at-city-council-meeting/

item.title: Release the Epstein Files. All of Them. Apparently, That's Too Fucking Much to Ask.
item.description:
Somewhere in America, there are people who know exactly what happened to children exploited by Jeffrey Epstein. And somehow, demanding transparency about one of the most notorious sex-trafficking scandals in modern history is treated like an unreasonable fucking request.
We're talking about a convicted sex offender who operated in circles filled with billionaires, politicians, celebrities and some of the most powerful people on the planet. And the public is supposed to believe that asking who enabled him is somehow controversial? Are you fucking kidding me? Here's a radical suggestion. Release every document that can legally be made public. Protect victims' identities. Protect witnesses. Preserve legitimate investigations. But stop treating the reputations of powerful people like they're more sacred than accountability. THAT'S NOT JUSTICE. THAT'S PUBLIC RELATIONS. And before someone starts screaming that every name in an address book is automatically guilty: No. Being photographed with Epstein isn't proof of a crime. Appearing in a flight log isn't a conviction. Evidence matters. Due process matters. Which is precisely why we need facts instead of conspiracy theories filling the fucking vacuum. The victims deserve more than another round of politicians promising transparency while everyone argues over which political party might look worse. Sexual exploitation isn't a team sport. There shouldn't be a Republican version of justice and a Democratic version of justice. There should be JUSTICE. Period. That's why I wanted a little girl painting this message on a wall. Not another politician holding a press conference. Not another billionaire issuing a carefully worded denial. Just a child demanding something that shouldn't require a goddamn protest: RELEASE ALL EPSTEIN FILES. The powerful have lawyers, publicists, political connections and entire institutions capable of protecting their interests. Victims deserve protection, too. Release what can lawfully be released. Investigate credible evidence. Prosecute crimes wherever the evidence leads. NO SPECIAL TREATMENT. NO POLITICAL EXEMPTIONS. NO FUCKING COVER-UPS. And never forget who this is supposed to be about. THE VICTIMS. #EpsteinFiles #ReleaseTheFiles #JusticeForVictims #Accountability #Transparency #JeffreyEpstein #HumanTraffickingAwareness #SurvivorsMatter #NoOneAboveTheLaw #PoliticalSatire #StreetArt #Justice #ProtectChildren

item.title: GovBrief Today #617
item.description: Donald Trump cleared Russia to sell diesel to the world after a call with Vladimir Putin. With Ukrainian peace negotiators in Miami today, his Treasury Department opened the market to Russian diesel for six months, only three weeks after Trump signed a law to cut off Russia’s oil money. Last month he demanded that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy “stop knocking out diesel fuel in Russia.” Zelenskyy answered today by agreeing, with one condition. Ukraine will stop setting Russian refineries on fire if Russia stops destroying Ukraine’s power grid. “Russia will repay the diesel with further terror and perfidy,” he said.
